items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: we had got a job, a one nighter down there with some guy by the name of Novak

ctx.x: But we had got a job, a one nighter down there with some guy by the name of Novak, some party M. And you could drink, people served you all the drinks you wanted, but I didn't want to drink, I wanted something to eat. (LAUGHTER). But the guy paid me after the job and I went to eat. I was

starving. And I got in this place and I ordered King Fish. Soup, King Fish and by the time I got to the King Fish I was eating so fast that I just couldn't hold it down. I had to run out and got sick. And the waitress said what's wrong? And I said, I've by then it was. haven't eaten in three or four days. So she said, well just eat some soup and you know.
